plugins.name: specboard
plugins.description: A visualised spec-driven development board. Every screen is a row — PRD → wireframe → screenshot → test — and staleness is derived, never tracked: edit the requirements and the wireframe goes stale, change the wireframe and the screenshot goes stale. Two human gates decide is-this-what-I-meant and did-you-build-it; contradictions across requirements are surfaced for you to adjudicate.
